cards.sentence_en: Örebro is known for its castle.
cards.note: känd för = known for. sitt = its own (points back to Örebro).

cards.sentence_en: It's an old building.
It was built a long time ago.
cards.note: -s passive: byggde = built, byggdes = was built. för länge sen = a long time ago.

cards.sentence: Det är ett av Sveriges kändaste slott.
cards.sentence_en: It's one of Sweden's most famous castles.

cards.sentence: En liten sol ser vi bakom molnen.
cards.sentence_en: We can see a little sun behind the clouds.

cards.forms: fryser till is · frös till is · har frusit till is
cards.sentence_en: But in winter it freezes into ice.
cards.note: Same verb as jag fryser = I'm cold.

cards.sentence: Det är också snö här i trappan.
cards.sentence_en: There's also snow here on the stairs.
cards.note: One trappa is a whole staircase. A single step is ett trappsteg.

cards.sentence_en: This bird is called a pigeon.

cards.forms: flyger iväg · flög iväg · har flugit iväg
cards.english: to fly away, to fly off
cards.sentence_en: The birds fly away.

cards.sentence: Den står på pelare, högst upp en staty.
cards.sentence_en: It stands on a pillar, and at the very top a statue.
Here's a sign.

cards.sentence: Vi bor också på en planet som kallas jorden.
cards.sentence_en: We also live on a planet called the Earth.
cards.note: Without the article, jord = soil, earth in a pot.

cards.sentence_en: Here's a bicycle pump.
cards.note: Verb: pumpa. Swedes say pumpa cykeln = pump up the bike's tyres.

cards.sentence_en: And a tall lamppost.
Here are his lips.
Two lips and teeth.
An ear.

cards.forms: lika lång som · lika stor som
cards.sentence_en: I'm as tall as the statue.
cards.note: Vi är lika långa = we're the same height.

cards.sentence_en: It's a slope going down.
It slopes.

cards.sentence: I backen kan man åka ner med pulka.
cards.sentence_en: On the slope you can slide down on a sled.
cards.note: Very Swedish winter fun: åka pulka = go sledging. A wooden sled is en kälke.

cards.sentence: Här finns en pelare med massa reklam.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a pillar with lots of ads.

cards.sentence: Här är en stor affisch, en mindre affisch.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a big poster, a smaller poster.
It's advertising for different events.
cards.note: Pronounced the French way. Everyday Swedish also uses the loanword ett event.

cards.sentence_en: It's a loanword from English.

cards.sentence: Här är en sparkcykel och en till sparkcykel.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a scooter and another scooter.
cards.note: sparka (to kick) + cykel. An electric one is an elsparkcykel.

cards.forms: går på el · gick på el
cards.sentence_en: The scooter runs on electricity.
cards.note: gå på = run on: bilen går på bensin.

cards.sentence_en: The restaurant has a menu, different dishes.

cards.sentence: Det är tidigt på morgonen så restaurangerna har inte öppnat än.
cards.sentence_en: It's early in the morning, so the restaurants haven't opened yet.

cards.sentence: Där inne kan man måla med en penna.
cards.sentence_en: In there you can paint with a brush.
cards.note: penna is usually a pen or pencil; a paintbrush is en pensel.

cards.sentence_en: On this building there are balconies.
A corner.
Yet another statue.
And someone has put a beer bottle (there).
cards.note: ställa = put something so it stands; lägga = lay it down.

cards.sentence_en: They're naked.
They have no clothes.
cards.note: Only used in the plural. ett klädesplagg = one item of clothing.

cards.sentence: När det är små stenar så här på marken, då kallar vi det grus.
cards.sentence_en: When there are little stones like this on the ground, we call it gravel.
The ground is covered with gravel.

cards.sentence: Och när vi går på isen är det halt.
cards.sentence_en: And when we walk on the ice it's slippery.
cards.note: Det är halt ute is something you hear all winter in Sweden.

cards.sentence_en: You can slip.
cards.note: Also a noun: halka = slippery road conditions.

cards.sentence_en: The sky opens up.

cards.forms: tittar fram · tittade fram · har tittat fram
cards.english: to peek out, to come out
cards.sentence: Ett litet hål där solen tittar fram.
cards.sentence_en: A little hole where the sun peeks out.
Rays of sunshine are coming through.
The bus is dirty.

cards.forms: hänger med · hängde med · har hängt med
cards.english: to come along, to tag along
cards.sentence: Tack för att ni hängde med oss i Örebro på torget och vi ses nästa gång.
cards.sentence_en: Thanks for coming along with us in Örebro on the square, and see you next time.
